rec.name: PDP Collapsible Info Box with Tooltip & Video
rec.status: Built — documented (Slite doc reviewed, product image added)

what.text: A colored info box placed in the PDP buy box, near the variant picker and ATC button. It shows a bold heading with an optional '?' tooltip icon, a short text paragraph and an optional video with a poster image and play button. The box can be made collapsible: a chevron at the right toggles it open or closed, and it can open by default. Content is set per product via metafields, so the box only appears on products that have data. Examples: 'Handover meeting required' on the ARDAP pest-control spray and a similar test on a demo store.

why.text: It puts product-specific information (conditions, requirements, usage or handover notes) right at the decision point, so surprises don't appear after the click. The tooltip adds detail on demand without cluttering the page. A short video explains complex or advice-heavy products better than text and builds trust. The collapsible mode keeps the buy box compact for users who don't need the details. The tinted, bordered box makes the message stand out from surrounding content.

how.text: 1) In main-product.liquid, add the schema block 'CRO | Collapsible box' (type cro_pdp_collapsible_box, limit 1). 2) Create the snippet ed-cro-pdp-collapsible-box.liquid. It renders only if the product metafield standard.pdp_collapsible_box exists. It outputs scoped CSS from the block settings, the heading with an optional tooltip (pure CSS, data-tip, hover/focus), the paragraph, and a video with poster and play overlay. 3) If 'Enable Collapsible' is on, the content is wrapped in a button/accordion with an animated chevron (aria-expanded) and a small JS toggle script; otherwise it is always open. 4) Render the snippet from the block in the PDP template, then fill the metafield per product. Following feedback, content entry was changed from one raw JSON to separate fields (title, tooltip content, text content, video, video thumbnail) via a metaobject-style structure. The full code is in the ticket attachment (the JS part of the snippet is truncated in the source).

items: Space top / space bottom (-16 to 32 px)
Tooltip: text color, background, border color, arrow color
Mobile: space top, space bottom, heading size, content size
Content metafield fields: title, tooltip content, text content, video file, video thumbnail

dependencies.text: Product metafield standard.pdp_collapsible_box (metaobject/JSON type) with fields title, tooltip_content, content, video (file) and video_thumbnail (image). Theme needs a product section (main-product.liquid) that supports app-style blocks. Uses Liquid filters image_url and file_url. No app needed. Assumes custom element names (ed-collapsible-wrap) and an inline JS toggle. The CSS breakpoint is 1000px (mobile settings below that). The snippet's video play handler is not visible in the truncated code, so it is an assumption that one exists.

items: Return / complaint rate or support tickets for the product topic
Video play rate and watch time
Scroll depth / engagement in the buy box

images.caption: Final UI: tinted, bordered box with heading, tooltip '?' icon, chevron, body text and video with play button on a poster
Theme editor on the ARDAP PDP: block placed between Inventory and Buy buttons, with the settings panel (border, colors, spacing, sizes, collapsible, tooltip)
Same block on a demo store with custom colors, radius and sizes, showing the settings are flexible and reusable
